title: Conditional Classical Latent-Error Coincidence Identities: No Physical Syndrome Filter Supplied

theorems.name: Single-Step Coincidence Renormalization and p* = 2/3 Purification Crossover
theorems.statement: For the symmetric nearest-neighbor kernel K_eta(0) = 1 - p, K_eta(+-1) = p/2 on Z_q, single-step coincidence pruning succeeds with probability P_acc^(1)(p) = (1 - p)^2 + p^2 / 2 and changes fundamental visibility by lambda_1^(1)(p) - lambda_1(p) = p(1 - p)(2 - 3p)(1 - cos(2*pi/q)) / (2*P_acc^(1)(p)), which is positive for 0 < p < 2/3, zero at p* = 2/3, and negative for 2/3 < p < 1.

theorems.name: Exact Telescoping 2^L-Moment Identity for Depth-L Tree Survival
theorems.statement: Across L recursive binary coincidence-pruning layers consuming K = 2^L leaves, the surviving root error distribution is K^(L)(e) = K_eta(e)^(2^L) / sum_z K_eta(z)^(2^L), and the joint survival probability prod_(l=1)^L (P_acc^(l))^(2^(L-l)) telescopes identically to the 2^L-th moment norm sum_(e in Z_q) K_eta(e)^(2^L).

theorems.name: Conditional Classical SNR Proxy Upper Bound Only
theorems.statement: For a conditional CLASSICAL retained-error posterior, SNR_proxy=P_surv*lambda^2<=P_surv<=1. Comparisons with K*lambda_base^2 are finite diagnostics, not a certified universal dominance theorem; q3,p2/3 has both proxies exactly zero.
